user.title: Connect E.ON Next
user.description: Paste a refresh token from a logged-in eonnext.com session. Run `tools/get_refresh_token.py` from the integration's repository to get one.

reauth_confirm.title: E.ON Next login expired
reauth_confirm.description: The saved login no longer works. Log in to eonnext.com again and paste the new refresh token.

reconfigure.title: Replace refresh token
reconfigure.description: Paste a new refresh token from a logged-in eonnext.com session.

error.invalid_auth: E.ON Next rejected the refresh token. It may have expired or already been used.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach E.ON Next. Check the logs for details.
error.no_prepay_meters: No smart meters in prepayment mode were found on this account.

abort.already_configured: This E.ON Next account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That refresh token belongs to a different E.ON Next account.
